content.title: What channel is Iowa State vs. Kentucky on? Time, TV schedule, live stream to watch March Madness Round 2 game
content.text: Otega OwehWhat channel is Iowa State vs. Kentucky on? Time, TV schedule, live stream to watch March Madness Round 2 game originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.AdvertisementThe No. 2 seed Iowa State Cyclones and No. 7 seed Kentucky Wildcats are set for a Midwest Region showdown on Sunday, but both teams enter the second round dealing with the emotional and physical fallout of a wild opening Friday. Iowa State advanced with a convincing 108-74 win over Tennessee State, while Kentucky survived an overtime thriller against Santa Clara to set up this top-25 clash in St. Louis.The Cyclones' victory was dampened by a significant blow to their rotation when All-American forward Joshua Jefferson suffered a left ankle injury just minutes into the game. Jefferson, a versatile 6-9 playmaker averaging nearly 17 points and 8 rebounds, had to be helped off the floor and later appeared on the bench in a walking boot. While X-rays were negative and coach T.J. Otzelberger has labeled him "day-to-day," his availability for Sunday remains the biggest question mark of the weekend for Iowa State.Kentucky arrives at the second round thanks to one of the most improbable shots in tournament history. Trailing by three with just 2.4 seconds left in regulation, Otega Oweh sprinted down the floor and banked in a 40-foot heave at the buzzer to force overtime. Oweh’s heroics — part of a career-high 35-point performance — reignited a Wildcats team that had struggled with consistency late in the season, giving Mark Pope’s squad a massive wave of momentum heading into Sunday.AdvertisementIf Jefferson is unable to go, Iowa State will lean even more heavily on Tamin Lipsey and Milan Momcilovic to navigate Kentucky's length. The Wildcats, led by Oweh and big man Mouhamed Dioubate, will look to exploit the interior if the Cyclones are missing their primary rim protector and rebounder. It’s a matchup of Iowa State’s elite defense against a Kentucky offense that finally found its spark in the clutch.Here's what you need to know about Sunday's matchup between Iowa State and Kentucky, including broadcast information and start time.TV channel: CBSAdvertisementThe second-round game between Iowa State and Kentucky will be broadcast nationally on CBS. The broadcast team of Spero Dedes (play-by-play), Jim Spanarkel (analyst), and Jon Rothstein (reporter) will be on the call from St. Louis.Fans can stream the game live on Fubo, which offers a free trial for new subscribers so you can try the service before you buy.Stream ESPN, ABC, CBS, Fox and 100+ top channels of live TV and sports without cable.
